data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2019 the syndicate had opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 11.009m (2018 comparative). Using the gross claims development triangle the syndicate shows a small gross adverse prior-year development of GBP 0.629m (primarily for the 2017 underwriting year), representing a ~5.7% movement relative to opening gross reserves. The trustees note a net deterioration in prior years of GBP 0.3m after reinsurance. The movement is linked to adverse development on catastrophe-exposed property business (notably the 2018 hurricanes and Californian wildfires) and general reserve development uncertainty.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in the net provisions for claims includes a deterioration of GBP 0.3m in respect of reserves set in prior years (2018: deterioration of GBP 0.1m).

The syndicate has material exposure to the hurricanes Florence and Michael and California Wildfires in the 2018 year of account. This increases the uncertainty of the syndicate's total reserves but does not increase that uncertainty in an adverse direction significantly beyond the normal range of uncertainty for insurance liabilities at this stage of development.
data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year movement derived from the published gross claims development triangle (2017 column) because no explicit gross 'movement in prior year provisions' table was provided. The report also quotes a net deterioration of GBP 0.3m (after reinsurance). The gross vs net difference is noted. The segmental premium breakdown is limited; premiums are classified as 'reinsurance accepted' only.
